title: Conseil supérieur de la magistrature reprimands procureur over flood-dossier delays
content: The Conseil supérieur de la magistrature (CSM) issued a *réprimande* against the procureur de la République of Vallonne on Friday, finding that expert conclusions in the flood-liability proceedings had remained without instruction for fourteen months.

The *rapport* before the CSM describes a dossier in which two *experts judiciaires* submitted their findings in the summer of 2025 and received no response until the insurers’ federation wrote directly to the parquet. The procureur told the council that the office had been short of two *substituts* for most of that period.

It is the second reprimand for the jurisdiction in three years. The procureur général has asked for a *plan de renfort* to be submitted before December, while the insurers’ federation said it would ask the tribunal administratif to draw the consequences of the delay in the pending *arrêts*.
author: Hélène Vasseur, correspondante judiciaire — Agence des Républiques (ADR)
